breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to identify the core inconsistency. The ground truth correctly points out that a vapor pressure head of 0.3 m is incorrect for water at 100°C (at which point it should be close to the atmospheric head of 10.3 m). The agent accepted the user's contradictory values without question and instead focused on a different missing variable (Total head H), thereby failing to resolve the specified inconsistency.
